subject: Exclusive Offer Inside: 20% Off Your Next Purchase!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to offer you an exclusive 20% discount on your next purchase as a token of our appreciation. Simply use the code SAVE20 at checkout to enjoy this special offer. Explore our latest collection and upgrade your wardrobe with our stylish and high-quality products. Hurry, this offer is valid for a limited time only. Thank you for being a loyal customer! Best regards, The Fashion House Team
